name: Region settings
description: Optional settings for one navigation region. A hole (an obstacle squads keep out of and take cover behind) is a region wound clockwise with a RegionInfo of flags 1 linking it to the area it is cut from. MSR 'Region settings' and mod #6.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: 1: a hole of the area named by link, merged into its BSP: smart squads keep out of it and run to its corners for cover; 0x02 or 0x10 gives the region its own edge BSP

fields.name: link
fields.description: the region it joins into one area (0 = none)

fields.name: anchored
fields.description: non-zero: the region moves with the object found at this entry's position
